# Mongabay India

> > Mongabay India provides in-depth environmental journalism and conservation news covering India's biodiversity, climate action, and ecological challenges.

Mongabay India is a leading environmental news platform dedicated to reporting on conservation issues, wildlife protection, climate change, and environmental policy across India. The site combines investigative journalism, multimedia content, and expert analysis to inform readers about India's most pressing environmental challenges and solutions.

## Key Topics

- Environmental journalism
- India environment
- Climate action
- Wildlife protection
- Biodiversity conservation
- Forests and deforestation
- Climate change
- Renewable energy
- Agricultural sustainability
- Environmental policy
- Air pollution
- Sacred groves
- Mizoram
- Rajasthan
- Environmental clearance

## Main Content Hub

- [Homepage](https://india.mongabay.com): Mongabay India's main landing page featuring the latest environmental news and conservation updates
- [Articles](https://india.mongabay.com/articles): In-depth environmental journalism articles on India's conservation and climate action initiatives
- [Features](https://india.mongabay.com/features): Comprehensive feature stories on India's environmental challenges and conservation efforts
- [All News Archive](https://india.mongabay.com/list/all): Complete archive of conservation news and environmental content published on Mongabay India

## Multimedia Content

- [Videos](https://india.mongabay.com/videos): Video documentaries and reports on India's wildlife, biodiversity, and environmental issues
- [Podcasts](https://india.mongabay.com/podcasts): Audio series exploring nature, wildlife, climate change, and biodiversity topics across India
- [Shorts](https://india.mongabay.com/shorts): Short-form video and text content on India's environmental policy and impact assessments
- [Special Issues](https://india.mongabay.com/specials): In-depth special reports on climate innovations and India's protected landscapes

## Recent Investigations & Reports

- [Rodents boom when bamboo blooms with no solution in sight](https://india.mongabay.com/2026/03/rodents-boom-when-bamboo-blooms-with-no-solution-in-sight): Report on Mizoram's bamboo flowering-triggered rodent crisis and its agricultural impact
- [The desperate battle of Mizoram's farmers with rats](https://india.mongabay.com/video/2026/03/the-desperate-battle-of-mizorams-farmers-with-rats): Video report documenting Mizoram farmers' struggle with bamboo-triggered rat infestations
- [A 700 km-long foot march to save sacred groves from solar projects](https://india.mongabay.com/2026/03/villagers-set-on-a-700-km-long-foot-march-to-save-sacred-groves-from-solar-projects-in-rajasthan): Grassroots activism story from Rajasthan highlighting community opposition to solar projects on sacred groves
- [LPG supply shock exposes fragility of India's clean cooking strategy](https://india.mongabay.com/2026/03/lpg-supply-shock-exposes-fragility-of-indias-clean-cooking-strategy): Investigation into India's clean cooking energy policy and supply chain vulnerabilities
- [Betta lands await revival as areca nut cultivation undergoes change](https://india.mongabay.com/2026/03/betta-lands-await-revival-as-areca-nut-cultivation-undergoes-change): Feature on sustainable areca nut farming practices and forest regeneration in Karnataka
- [Chronic exposure to air pollution can influence dengue severity, study finds](https://india.mongabay.com/2026/03/chronic-exposure-to-air-pollution-can-influence-dengue-severity-study-finds): Research analysis on air pollution's impact on dengue severity and public health outcomes
- [Centre could take charge when state environmental authorities are non-functional](https://india.mongabay.com/short-article/2026/03/centre-could-take-charge-when-state-environmental-authorities-are-non-functional): Analysis of India's environmental governance structure and regulatory framework changes
- [Ward-level plans bring climate action closer to communities](https://india.mongabay.com/2026/03/ward-level-plans-bring-climate-action-closer-to-communities): Report on Bengaluru's ward-level climate action plans and community engagement initiatives
